verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents Query Assistant, which generates real Honeycomb queries from natural-language input. Its MCP server also lets AI agents query live telemetry and answer questions, and a community report confirms an LLM agent using that MCP server during incidents. missing for 10: in-depth Query Assistant documentation (accuracy, limits, editing of the generated query), explicit evidence that a chart or visualization is returned, independent hands-on corroboration of Query Assistant itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask questions of my telemetry in natural language and get a real query or chart back

citations.quote: Query Assistant is a feature that generates Honeycomb queries based on your natural language query (NLQ) input.
Connect Honeycomb to any AI agent that supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) so it can query your telemetry, investigate issues, and answer questions using your live Honeycomb data.
Query Builder allows you to construct queries against your data to produce results for investigation and further exploration.
An LLM agent given tool calls for each source, including Honeycomb's MCP server, can generate integrated hypotheses.
